deadline.cory_ruling_verbatim: Keepers will be set by 08/21 at 6pm

draftable_scope._focus_vs_outer: focus (200) is the working scope: 150 drafted plus 50 of headroom for runs, injuries and reaches. outer (250) is the widest Cory named and is the right scope for a question that must not clip the tail. Neither is a tuned constant -- both are Cory's ruling, quoted above, and drafted is derived.
draftable_scope._why_not_all_700: The board carries 700 players because the ingest carries 700. Only 150 get drafted. Reporting anything -- coverage, accuracy, agreement -- over all 700 measures the deep bench nobody takes, and it makes real sources look broken: Draft Sharks covers 35% of 700 and 94% of the top 200. The first number is true and useless, the second is the one that decides a pick.
draftable_scope.cory_ruling_verbatim: We really just need to focus on top 200 players maybe 250
draftable_scope.drafted_derivation: teams * rounds = 10 * 15 = 150. Every player who will be on a roster when the draft ends. Cory's last pick is 148.

pick_order.numbering_note: A keeper occupies his pick slot; the pick is not removed and nothing after it shifts up. Verified against seasons 2023/2024/2025 in league_history: 150 picks and round 4 at overall 31 every year, with 0, 23 and 20 keepers respectively. `picks` is the BOARD (depth: how many players leave the pool). `live_picks` is how many SELECTIONS happen. They differ by the keeper count and conflating them is a real defect this carries both to prevent.

grab_by.headline: TAKE-NOW: RB — Cam Skattebo (lose ~1.322/wk if you wait; grab-by pick 33)

ongoing.caveat: excludes weeks a player did not play, so it slightly OVERSTATES what a held wire add delivers; the gap to per_week is a floor

wire_level_source.note: Real acquisition-week medians from draft/tools/wire_level.js, 2023-2025. K/DEF absent: nflverse is offense-only, unmeasurable from this source, not zero. Regenerate: node draft/tools/emit_wire_level.js

payouts._comment: GROUND TRUTH for the money function. All objective math derives from this file. PER-SEASON keyed by year (master sheet, 2026-08-08): the structure CHANGED across eras, so money math must pick the season's own config. `current` mirrors the active season (2026) for the money-function default + backward compat. E[$] = Sum_w P(weekly-high,w)*weekly + P(RS champ)*champ + P(RS 2nd)*runner_up + Sum_k P(finish k)*playoff[k], using THAT season's amounts.
payouts.weekly_high_scope_note: Master sheet (in writing): the weekly-$100 high is REGULAR SEASON ONLY — weeks 1-15 pay, playoff weeks do not.

2023.note: League year one — SMALLER pot. Corrects the earlier era-mismatch: Cory's 2023 THIRD paid $400, not $475.

2024.note: Playoffs 675/550/500/400 — DIFFERS from 2026. Corrects MarianSaar 2nd=$550 (not 575), cashworth 3rd=$500 (not 475).

2026.note: ACTIVE season. Playoffs changed 2nd/3rd to 575/475 vs 2024-25's 550/500.

2027.note: PLANNED reversion (playoff 2nd/3rd back to 550/500) + a $500 buy-in vote PENDING. Not final — the January rollover diff (Part 12 / Annual) catches the outcome. Do not use for grading.

regular_season.tiebreak_note: Master sheet rules tab (confirmed): RS ties break on TOTAL POINTS. Corroborated by Cory's 2024 8.2-point tiebreak miss.

weekly_high.note: 37.5% of the pot — regular season only, paid to the league-high score each week.

regular_season.note: Rewards consistent winning; the floor still buys RS money + playoff entry.

playoffs.note: Flat gradient: top-4 ENTRY (~$400 floor) is the real prize.

draft.note: Draft is UNTIMED (pick_timer=0 at source). Hard time-pressure cues dropped; the LRM countdown counts PICKS.

rules.pick_trade_note: League rule (master sheet): traded picks must swap within ONE round of each other — a hard constraint for the pick-trade valuator.
rules.pending_votes_note: Live governance on the Votes tab — 2027 config may move; the January rollover diff covers it.

payouts._data_spine_note: The master sheet's own TOTAL column is STALE (excludes 2025 for several owners) — the exact disease the data spine cures. Career money derives from YEAR columns, never the sheet Total.

predicted_keepers.note: PREDICTED slates for MOCK/REHEARSAL ONLY — never applied to the live board (Cory, 2026-08-11: a prediction rendered indistinguishably from a fact IS a fact as far as behaviour is concerned). Real designations are read from live Sleeper by the nightly draft-data rebuild; there is no keeper-watch process. Assumes keeper-eligibility (max_years=3 not verifiable for opponents).

keeper_lock_deadline.cory_ruling_verbatim: Keepers will be set by 08/21 at 6pm

keeper_slate.reason: only 6/10 teams have keepers placed on the draft — incomplete; the rest are still predicted, not confirmed

withheld_from_board.reason: designations exist but the slate is not confirmed; applying a partial slate would make the board look authoritative and move once BEFORE the move that matters

arithmetic_check.rule: my_first_pick == (N*teams) + (my_slot if N+1 odd else teams+1-my_slot), N = MY keeper count
arithmetic_check.independent_of: how many players any other team keeps
arithmetic_check.condition: TRUE ONLY WHILE I KEEP EXACTLY 3. The RULE holds for any keeper count; the NUMBER moves with mine. First pick is the (N+1)th entry of the pre-keeper snake: keep 0 -> 8, keep 1 -> 13, keep 2 -> 28, keep 3 -> 33.

projection_correctness.ruling: Cory 2026-08-16: 'Don't agree with timelines we fix now'

scoring_gap_vs_adp_market.what_this_is: points our scoring adds to the SAME projected stat line versus the scoring our ADP feed is priced in. A measurement, not a correction: nothing here changes a price.
scoring_gap_vs_adp_market.what_this_is_not: evidence that ADP is wrong. It is evidence that ADP answers a different question than our projections do, at one position.

own_model.promotion: REC-3 bar cleared by own_v6 at all four positions; Cory accepted 2026-08-16 ('YES on V6'), upgrading his same-day own_v4 acceptance

rookie_capital_prior.cory_approval_verbatim: I need you to fix this model, even if we need to lower our standards for this year only. give me a draft tool that gives me a chance at edge... lets at least take a swing. take ownership and give me something.

draft_capital.join_note: the current class joins BY NAME — its capital store carries no sleeper_id — so unmatched rows are reported here rather than dropped silently

late_trajectory.construction: F7: prior-season late-window ppg (weeks LATE_FROM..17, >= LATE_MIN_GAMES games) minus prior-season ppg; constants from backtest/own_model_v2.py; component stores, per A's 2026-08-17 availability-consumer ruling
late_trajectory.evidence: hotter-finish side won 58.0% of 176 historical near-ties, 2023-25 (Wilson 95% CI [.506, .650]; p=.035, Bonferroni x9=.31 — a lean, not a law)

proj_mean_composition.override_ruled: Cory 2026-08-16 — for a BLEND, not a swap

display_consensus_sources.note: count of RAW per-source columns available to consensus.js — a display sanity check beside the valuation, never an input to proj_mean. Partial and uneven by position; K/DEF are Sleeper-only by necessity.

adp.fallback_ordering_basis: the caller's projection map where present; the remainder share one price because nothing separates them. NOT search_rank — the board does not carry it, and it is a popularity rank rather than a value

veto.note: A coverage gap only tilts a board if the blend MOVES the blocs differently. This is the test that refused the 2026-08-16 attempt. A small rookie n makes a pass a WEAK null, not a strong clearance.

draftsharks_attach._ruling: Cory 2026-08-19: push the new mean projections, ceilings and floors

C1_band_is_draftsharks_own_percentage.why: Cory asked for floor/ceiling the SAME % from mean as Draft Sharks'. If the percentage is not identical we invented a band.

C2_vorp_identity_holds_after_rederivatio.why: vorp == proj_mean - replacement[pos]. If this fails, the board's value term disagrees with its own projections — the exact defect this script exists to avoid creating.

C3_known_positive_the_board_actually_mov.why: rule 3e. A no-op would look exactly like a clean run, so the run must PROVE it did something before any of it is believed.

C5_both_arms_of_corys_toggle_are_on_the_.why: Cory wants to toggle between a Draft-Sharks model and a blended-mean model. Both numbers must sit on every row that has them, or the toggle is re-deriving one arm at read time.

C6_published_replacement_block_matches_t.why: the board ships board['replacement'] SEPARATELY from the per-row field. C2 checked the row copy -- the one I had just written -- and passed while the published block was stale and three tests failed. A control has to check what SHIPS, not what you maintained.

multisource_attach.why: Cory 2026-08-21: the blend uses seven sources and the Big Board toggle offered four. These four were ingested and blended but never rankable, because alt_source_rankings.py can only rank a source whose projection is a field on the board.
